The `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException` occurred because [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r2/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L29) configured the Keystore AES key with `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`. For symmetric Keystore keys, this requires user authentication (device PIN/biometrics) before any cryptographic operation—including `cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, ...)` during `save(token)`. When the user taps "Sign in", no device authentication has occurred, causing `Cipher.init` to fail.

### Fix
Updated [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r2/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L29) to set `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)` on the `KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder` and removed the user authentication parameters, allowing session token encryption and decryption without requiring OS-level biometric or credential authentication.
